extracted.name: Strawberry Banana Peanut Butter Smoothie
extracted.description: This easy smoothie is made with strawberry, banana, peanut butter, and nonfat plain yogurt for a creamy protein-packed treat with no added sugar.
instruction_lines: Place yogurt, banana, strawberries, and peanut butter into a blender. Add ice cubes and purée until smooth.
